verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine filing channels, MeF and IRIS A2A, so a test or sandbox environment is a fair question here. However, no evidence item documents a sandbox, test environment or assurance-testing rail that keeps tests away from production data. The cited items cover only credentialed production intake, enrollment and identity-proofing requirements.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
